# GEUT

> Software Development Studio specializing in distributed systems, P2P technology, and modern web development.

## About

GEUT is a software development studio founded by experienced engineers passionate about building reliable, scalable systems. We specialize in:
- Distributed systems and P2P protocols
- Full-stack web development (React, Astro, Node.js, Bun, etc.)
- Developer tools and open source
- Technical consulting and team augmentation

## Team

- Martin Acosta - Backend Architect, CTO
- Diego Paez - Systems Thinker, CEO
- Esteban Primost - Frontend-focused Fullstack, CPO
